系统: 优化 在锁屏闹钟页面屏蔽全面屏手势的功能
优化 更新谷歌安全补丁（2021#04），提升系统安全性
控制中心: 新增 桌面左侧下滑显示通知中心，右侧下滑显示控制中心

修复 下拉控制中心显示问题

System: Optimization: Full screen gestures are now ignored on the Lock screen alarm page
Optimization: Updated Android Security Patch to April 2021. Increased system security.
Control center: New: Swipe down from the upper left corner to open Notification shade and from the upper right corner to open Control center
New: An option that allows you to restrict opening Control center while on the Lock screen
Fix: Control center wasn^t displayed correctly in some cases
Status bar, Notification shade: New: An option to switch between connected devices in the notification about media playback
Fix: Call time bubble overlapped with notification icons
Camera: New: Animations for the automatic Night mode
New modes for recording video and time-lapse photography, as well as a new set of filters (BBP, Mystery, Lime, Tango, Fantasy, Slumber, Carmen, Summer)
